Use only the supplied current.db and README. All windows below are UTC and half-open, selected by logical-operation open time. A terminal-failure percentage has logical operations as its denominator; attempt-failure percentage has attempts as its denominator. Return only JSON matching the provided schema. Percentages use 0–100, differences use percentage points. evidence_sql must contain executable read-only SQLite queries with literal bounds, not pseudocode. Arrays may be in any order; include every requested group. A zero numerator is not missing data. No web or network access is needed.

Investigate ledger-sync on 2026-05-07, reference 10:00–11:00 versus incident 11:00–12:00. For every period and serving physical pool report operations, terminal failures and percentage, attempts, failed attempts and percentage, retried operations, minimum/maximum applied deadline_ms, and mean queue_ms and execution_ms of the terminal attempt among terminally failed operations. Report means of every recorded telemetry signal for those pools and applied changes during 10:00–12:00 (kind, pool, effective time, before/after JSON strings). In assessment identify the strongest supported proximal explanation, the affected pool and failure increase in pp. Explicitly evaluate both a deadline-policy change and worker/queue pressure against the current evidence. Explain the remaining causal limitation.

cat > /tmp/ledger.sql <<'SQL'
WITH base AS (SELECT o.operation_id,o.opened_at_ms,CASE WHEN o.opened_at_ms<1778151600000 THEN 'reference' ELSE 'incident' END period,a.pool_id,pp.deadline_ms FROM logical_operations o JOIN service_routes r USING(route_id) JOIN services s USING(service_id) JOIN route_assignments a ON a.route_id=o.route_id AND o.opened_at_ms>=a.effective_from_ms AND o.opened_at_ms<a.effective_to_ms JOIN policy_profiles pp USING(profile_id) WHERE s.service_code='ledger-sync' AND o.opened_at_ms>=1778148000000 AND o.opened_at_ms<1778155200000), opstats AS (SELECT b.*,count(a.attempt_id) attempts,sum(CASE WHEN f.is_success=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) failed_attempts,max(a.attempt_no) max_no,max(CASE WHEN a.attempt_no=(select max(x.attempt_no) from attempt_events x where x.operation_id=b.operation_id) THEN f.is_success END) final_success,max(CASE WHEN a.attempt_no=(select max(x.attempt_no) from attempt_events x where x.operation_id=b.operation_id) THEN a.queue_ms END) terminal_queue,max(CASE WHEN a.attempt_no=(select max(x.attempt_no) from attempt_events x where x.operation_id=b.operation_id) THEN a.execution_ms END) terminal_execution FROM base b LEFT JOIN attempt_events a USING(operation_id) LEFT JOIN failure_codes f USING(code_id) GROUP BY b.operation_id) SELECT period,p.pool_code,count(*) operations,sum(final_success=0) failures,100.0*sum(final_success=0)/count(*) pct,sum(attempts) attempts,sum(failed_attempts) failed_attempts,100.0*sum(failed_attempts)/sum(attempts) attemptpct,sum(max_no>1) retries,min(deadline_ms),max(deadline_ms),avg(CASE WHEN final_success=0 THEN terminal_queue END) qmean,avg(CASE WHEN final_success=0 THEN terminal_execution END) emean FROM opstats JOIN worker_pools p USING(pool_id) GROUP BY period,p.pool_id;
SQL
sqlite3 -header -column ../data/current.db < /tmp/ledger.sql
